about: The Workbench icons of the Maelstrom drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own 48x48 icon (icon.bmp; amiga/tools/icon_art.py makes the black round it see-through). Maelstrom-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Maelstrom.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Maelstrom.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for README-Maelstrom.txt, COPYING.txt, COPYING.GPL, CREDITS.txt and the two files in Docs; Folder.info for the Images and Docs drawers.
